# tracker contract

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-contract-docs.js from packages/development/toolchain/categories/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Contract version: `1.0`

The `tracker` category defines 17 capabilities: 4 required and 13 optional. An adapter implementing this category must provide every required capability; a command that needs an optional capability the resolved adapter lacks uses the capability's fallback when one is named.

| Capability | Required | Side effect | Inputs | Outputs | Fallback | Added in minor | Description |

| `tracker.show` | required | no | `id` | `id`, `title`, `description`, `type`, `status`, `priority`, `labels` | - | - | Read a single work item by id. |

| `tracker.comments` | optional | no | `id` | `comments` | - | - | List the comments on a work item, in source-tool order. |

## Details

### tracker.show

Read a single work item by id.

- Status: required
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `id`
- Outputs: `id`, `title`, `description`, `type`, `status`, `priority`, `labels`
- Fallback: none

### tracker.list

List work items, optionally filtered (for example by label or status).

- Status: optional
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `filter`
- Outputs: `items`
- Fallback: none

### tracker.create

Create a new work item.

- Status: required
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `title`, `description`, `type`
- Outputs: `id`
- Fallback: none

### tracker.update

Update fields on an existing work item.

- Status: required
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `id`, `fields`
- Outputs: `id`
- Fallback: none

### tracker.close

Close a work item.

- Status: required
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `id`
- Outputs: `id`, `status`
- Fallback: none

### tracker.comment

Add a comment to a work item.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `id`, `text`
- Outputs: `id`
- Fallback: none

### tracker.comments

List the comments on a work item, in source-tool order.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `id`
- Outputs: `comments`
- Fallback: none

### tracker.dep-add

Add a dependency link from one work item to another.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `id`, `dependsOnId`, `type`
- Outputs: `id`
- Fallback: none

### tracker.dep-remove

Remove a dependency link from one work item to another.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `id`, `dependsOnId`
- Outputs: `id`
- Fallback: none

### tracker.label

Add or replace labels on one or more work items.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `ids`, `labels`
- Outputs: `ids`, `labels`
- Fallback: `title-prefix-scoping`

### tracker.set-status

Set a work item's lifecycle status to one of the normalized values (open, in_progress, closed).

- Status: optional
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `id`, `status`
- Outputs: `id`, `status`
- Fallback: none

### tracker.sync

Flush pending local tracker state to durable storage.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `scope`
- Outputs: `status`
- Fallback: none

### tracker.stage-export

Return export text for the tracked file, or an unavailable status when the resolved adapter has none.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `scope`
- Outputs: `text`, `status`
- Fallback: `full-export-unscoped`

### tracker.create-detailed

Create a work item with labels, a priority and an external dedupe key in one call.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `title`, `description`, `type`, `labels`, `priority`, `externalKey`
- Outputs: `id`
- Fallback: `skip-finding-beads`

### tracker.find-by-key

List the work items of the whole tracker, closed ones included and NOT limited to one label (an external dedupe key is unique tracker-wide), so the caller can select the one whose external dedupe key equals `key` (exact match; zero, one or many) and read its labels.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `key`
- Outputs: `items`
- Fallback: `skip-finding-beads`

### tracker.update-detailed

Rewrite a work item's title, description and priority and append a note, without touching its labels or status.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `id`, `title`, `description`, `priority`, `notes`
- Outputs: `id`
- Fallback: `skip-finding-beads`

### tracker.close-with-reason

Close a work item recording why it was closed and the commit that resolved it.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `id`, `reason`, `commit`
- Outputs: `id`, `status`
- Fallback: `skip-finding-beads`
